- `OwnerEmails.java` (extended) — added the blocklist `Set` (`mailinator.com`, `tempmail.com`, `guerrillamail.com`) plus `domainOf(...)` and `isDisposableDomain(...)`, keeping email-domain logic in the existing single-source-of-truth helper.
